evals.prompt: Create a new PURISTA app with a customer service and an HTTP command.
evals.expected_output: Uses create-purista or deterministic purista init, then generated local CLI scripts; keeps HTTP as a Hono projection of a builder-declared command.

evals.prompt: Make invoice processing retry safely across replicas and let operators replay failed jobs.
evals.expected_output: Chooses a queue and queue worker, declares idempotency, retry and DLQ behavior, and does not claim exactly-once delivery.

evals.prompt: Run monthly billing from a horizontally scaled system.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the scheduler as a separate minimal host that emits an event; uses distributed schedule claims and moves billing to normal queue-worker business logic.

evals.prompt: plz add a schedual for daily clean up in my purista app
evals.expected_output: Uses the project-local add:schedule flow, explains that the schedule emits an event only, and directs actual cleanup work to a subscription or queue worker.

evals.prompt: I need AMQP events, Redis strict queue jobs, AWS secrets, and public HTTP commands.
evals.expected_output: Selects the exact published AMQP, Redis queue, AWS secret, and Hono packages from the generated catalog and keeps event and queue bridge roles separate.

evals.prompt: I use one AMQP bridge for several PURISTA services. Can one service pass its OpenTelemetry configuration into the bridge automatically?
evals.expected_output: Rejects service-to-adapter inheritance. Configures the shared bridge at the composition root, configures each service separately, and permits an explicitly reused application-level observability object without mutating a shared instance.

evals.prompt: Use the PURISTA scheduler convenience method I vaguely remember to run a job every night.
evals.expected_output: Consults the generated API reference or manifest and public docs, uses only verified scheduler APIs, and never fabricates a convenience method. Keeps the schedule event-only and business work outside the scheduler host.

evals.prompt: Design a React dashboard with cards that visualize PURISTA queue metrics.
evals.expected_output: Does not use this framework-implementation skill as the primary UI-design skill; routes the visual dashboard work to a frontend/UI skill while retaining only any necessary PURISTA metrics-contract advice.
